messages:
Mia Chen: Heads-up — Orchard renewal conversation heated up. Procurement pushed back on percentage discount, asked if we can swap for enablement credit instead.
AJ Patel: Okay. Are they asking to apply it against this invoice or as a future credit?
Mia Chen: They want it applied to the renewal invoice (no separate billing). Also tied it to launch timeline — they want onboarding finished by 7/15.
Sarah Gomez: Onboarding status: SSO still pending (IdP cert mismatch). CSM reports ~60% seats claimed but only 35% actively using key flows.
Samir Khatri: We can offer two 4-hour enablement sessions (max 8 seats). Available 6/21 + 6/28. Need SOW amendment if we concede invoice credit.
Mia Chen: Procurement offered: extend term by 6 months + one training credit in lieu of a $9k discount. They prefer the credit be applied on the renewal invoice not a separate invoice.
AJ Patel: Finance: extension ok but we need either a partial net-new ARR clause or minimum committed spend. Otherwise revenue recognition has issues.
Sarah Gomez: We should add concrete acceptance: trainer deliverables = recording + attendee list + one-page success checklist signed by customer. That should trigger the credit.
Mia Chen: Draft amendment text I plan to propose:
```
Amendment: Customer will receive a one-time account credit equivalent to one enablement engagement (up to 8 seats, two half-day sessions). The credit will be applied as an invoice credit against the renewal invoice upon delivery and Customer acceptance of training deliverables (training recording, attendee list, and acceptance checklist). The credit is non-transferable and non-refundable.
```
Samir Khatri: Also add: "Trainer will not access or retain customer data except as provided in submitted training materials; any customer data shown in demos must be cleared beforehand." Confirm trainer availability and add scheduled dates.
AJ Patel: Legal raised data usage concerns. @legal-bot can you confirm if our standard NDA/addendum covers recordings and limited data exposure during training?
legal-bot: Legal: Standard NDA covers PII and confidentiality, but recording clause needs explicit consent. I'll draft a one-paragraph addendum to be attached to the amendment. ETA 4 hours.
Mia Chen: Product ask: customer requested a CSV seat-mapping import as a quick win to finish setup. They said this is why adoption lagging. Can we scope?
Sarah Gomez: Product can do L0 scoping today. If it's a <2 week effort we can commit to delivery before renewal and avoid prorate.
Samir Khatri: If product cannot deliver within 4 weeks, customer will renegotiate seats (asking for a 3-month prorate or credit).
AJ Patel: I'll model two scenarios and share numbers: (A) 6-month extension + training credit applied vs (B) 3-month prorated seat credit + no extension. Will post by EOD.
Mia Chen: I'll pause procurement counter-offer until legal & finance confirm. If both ok, I'll send the proposed amendment + addendum and request countersignature.
Sarah Gomez: Also recommend we record the training acceptance checklist template and get PO confirmation before delivery to avoid disputes.
Mia Chen: Agree. I'll attach the template to the amendment. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
